posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
[quote:0c14e04341="Record"]Hi,

is it possible to get a bigger hologram image than the filmsize (the physical hologram itself) when reconstruct?

Thanks[/quote:0c14e04341]

Yes, it's possible. The hologram forms a virtual window through which you view the scene. The size of the scene depends on how far back behind the plate the scene is, how diverging the reference beam is and how diverging the reconstruction beam is.
